page.content:
Tang emperor who commissions the scripture quest after the underworld dream.

How Emperor Taizong connects

  • Location: Chang'an — Taizong rules from Tang Chang'an.
  • Character: Tang Sanzang — Taizong commissions Sanzang to fetch the scriptures.

What is Emperor Taizong?

Taizong, in the novel's opening arc, tours the underworld, returns in debt to the dead, and sends Sanzang west so the dynasty may have true Buddhist texts.

Key threads lead to Chang'an and Tang Sanzang.
